links.comparator_used: Primary prompt (PP) without motivational cues, versus emotional prompt (EP) with motivational cues added to the PP structure
links.outcome: Relational/motivational tone (Composite Relationality Index) and content completeness against a 43-item ERAS-derived benchmark
links.effect: Almost all PP outputs had CRI of zero, while EP outputs frequently used modal verbs, affirmatives and empathetic expressions, with CRI up to 5.28. No statistically significant differences in completeness for any of the 43 features, and no factual inaccuracies, guideline inconsistencies or harmful statements were found.
links.quote: Emotional prompting substantially enhances the relational and motivational tone without improving content completeness.
